decisions.state_note: o000: visible window near x115–178, y160–223; dark slanted/curved fragment enters its upper-left area and meets left crop edge near y200. No endpoint established.

o001: window x115–178,y128–191 shows a dark fragment along left side, curving/slanting upward-right toward x145 at top crop; narrow white recess near x120,y151. Detector labels upright and rising-right portions; neither endpoint nor closure visible.

o002: window x115–178,y96–159 shows a thick curved junction near x132,y123 with an arm rising right through the upper-right crop; dark stroke continues below. Detector supports rising-right segment near x153,y115. Shape remains incomplete.

o003: window x115–178,y64–127 shows thick dark curve along lower area, rising at right toward x173,y78; a separate cropped dark sliver touches top near x145. Detector reports none. Connections beyond crop remain unknown.

o004: window x83–146,y64–127 shows white interior bordered by dark area above/left and a thick dark band below, running from x84,y103 toward x133,y122. Detector marks horizontal portion near (103,106). Possible loop remains unconfirmed.

o005: window x83–146,y32–95 shows thick arch rising from left near y76 to a horizontal crown near x121–137,y48, then bending down at right crop. Detector marks crown and rising-right band. Upper curved structure remains cropped on right.

o006: window x115–178,y32–95 shows a horizontal dark crown near y48 ending in a rounded rightward/downward cap near (149,60); a separate cropped dark fragment enters at right near y78. White gap separates these visible portions. Detector supports the crown.

o007: window x115–178,y64–127 again shows a thick lower curve rising to the right near (173,78), plus a cropped sliver at top near x145; white separates them locally. No detector instances. Lower continuation remains unresolved.

o008: window x115–178,y96–159 shows a thick junction near (132,123), an arm rising right through the crop, and a downward continuation near x129. Detector marks the rising-right arm; lower shape remains unknown.

o009: window x115–178,y128–191 shows dark stroke curving down-left from x145 near top to left crop near y177, with a narrow white recess near (120,152). Detector marks overlapping upright and rising-right portions. Lower continuation remains cropped.

o010: window x83–146,y128–191 shows dark curved sides surrounding a narrow white region near x111,y166; sides approach below but closure is cropped at bottom. Detector marks upright and rising-right portions on right side. Lower extent remains unknown.

o011: window x83–146,y160–223 shows a dark rounded bottom turn near y201, with white below and a narrow white interior above it; both sides continue through the top crop. Together with the upper arch and central junction recorded earlier, this supports an 8.
